## Information
Gonks originated in Sweden, to protect animals and houses, often viewed as the Nordic Santa. A lovely decorative character to have around the home this Christmas. Wearing a furry light grey hat, with a fluffy white beard and red jumper featuring silver line detail. The hat features a warm white decorative tip. The battery pack is located underneath the beard. The wired hat means that this can be shaped to any position of preference. Weighted base for stability. A cute and fun addition to the home this Christmas, ideal for gifting.
